matt (eng-runtime): quick triage — saw a throughput regression on mixtral-7b in the private pool when handling long prefixes. throughput down ~18% vs baseline. I dumped a RoPE scaling heatmap and KV eviction counters. seems like some heads' attention norms blow up after ~1024 tokens which triggers aggressive KV eviction + batcher oscillation. gdrive: https://redwood/g/rope-heatmaps/mixtral7b

Repro (local dedicated):
```
# run on perf node with dedicated model config
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.internal/api/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"mixtral-7b","input":"'"'A very long prompt... (repeat)"'","max_tokens":2048,"stream":false}'
```

matt (eng-runtime): attaching quick profiling excerpt (kv evict + batcher events):
```
KV_EVICT spikes: 0,0,1,2,3,10,45,120,300
BATCHER windows: [min_tokens=64,max_tokens=2048] inflight=4->1->4->1 repeated
latency p95: baseline 110ms -> regressed 140ms
flame: https://redwood/g/flame/mixtral7b-2977.html
```

tess (eng-runtime): can you paste the exact evict log lines and model-config used for onboarding?

matt (eng-runtime): evict lines & model meta:
```
[2026-07-12T14:33:21Z] model=mixtral-7b shard=0 KV_EVICT count=300 reason=rotary_scale_diverge head=7
[2026-07-12T14:33:21Z] batcher: pending=3 tokens=512 window=adaptive state=shrinking
model-config snippet: {"name":"mixtral-7b","max_seq":2048,"heads":32,"kv_dim":64,"rotary_scaling":null}
```

anya (eng-ml): this screams missing/incorrect rotary scaling. some safetensors exports we've seen omit rotary meta (rotary_alpha/rotary_scaling). our hf-parser currently defaults to 1.0 if missing which is wrong for Mixtral variants. also check for axis ordering — heads vs kv_dim mismatch can make per-head norms explode.

kevin (eng-platform): short-term mitigation: add model override in model-config to force rotary_scaling and explicit head->kv mapping. sample override below — can be applied via model overrides in the private cluster until conversion patch lands.
```
{"overrides": {"mixtral-7b": {"rotary_scaling": 0.125, "heads": 32, "kv_dim": 64 }}}
```

yusuf (perf): can we run the profiler with --kv-debug on that shard and produce a head-wise attention norm csv? I suspect head 6/7 are diverging. also try bumping batcher.min_batch_tokens to 128 to reduce oscillation; that usually smooths evictions at modest throughput cost.

li (infra): I'll add a conversion lint to hfparse to detect missing rotary fields in safetensors and error out. will also add a heuristic warning for head/kv_dim inconsistency (e.g., if heads*kv_dim doesn't match inferred embed size). planning a small PR today.

ops-bot: ticket created: INF-6342 "mixtral-7b rope scaling -> kv-evict + batcher oscillation" assigned to eng-runtime.

tess (eng-runtime): INF-6342 — assigning to matt for repro gist + canary override. add the failing request body and the node id. also note any repro variance between dedicated vs hosted.

matt (eng-runtime): on it — uploading a minimal repro gist now and starting a canary with the override in the private pool. will post results in this thread when done :thumbsup:
